The metadata and snippets highlighted "Milan" as his birthplace, but critical overlooked details in the viewport mentioned his contributions to the city of Pavia, such as the building of the Certosa di Pavia. As historical records confirm, Gian Galeazzo Visconti was born in Pavia, not Milan. The agent failed to properly analyze the broader context of the search results and cross-reference them for accuracy. This resulted in providing the wrong birthplace to the Planner.
